methodology: Fresh Chrome process/context per sample; HTTP cache and service workers disabled; identical readiness probes; reduced-motion enabled. Hardware GPU. Ready = later of controls-ready and a GPU fence completing after the entire first main-framebuffer scene frame. Alternating variant order per pair.
